# Daily AI Eval - 2026-10-10 (~7:50 AM PT) — morning rerun

**Answer: MIXED.** The daily Super Grok switch did its job Friday, and OpenRouter is under all caps. App chat was quiet, but 7-day real ok_rate fell (AI Editor generate bugs), and Super Grok is still far ahead of the week pace from Thursday/Friday burn. Saturday morning's first eval failed because the workstation was offline; this is the rerun with :4006/:3001 up (:5000 still down, skipped).

## Budget
- **OpenRouter** (auth key, ~7:46 AM PT): day **$0.17/$1.65**, week **$6.37/$11.50**, month **$25.63/$50**, balance **$11.40** (was $12.76 on Oct 8). Under all soft caps. No deepseek-v4-pro since Friday. Hermes logged ~$2.48 on z-ai/glm-5.3-flash Friday after the daily switch; week billed–logged gap ~$2.63 (not a new Relace spike today).
- **Super Grok**: last spoken reading **54% used** (Fri Oct 9 08:12 PT). Token estimate now **~59.6%** used (~40.4% left), **+0.8% today** vs daily budget **5.7%**. Pace **ahead** (expected ~27%, delta **+32.6**). Reset **Thu Oct 15 10:31 PT** (~5.1 days). Daily switch: **fired Fri 09:30** (today 5.7% ≥ budget → openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash); **restored Sat 00:00** to xai-oauth/grok-4.7. Mode this morning: **grok**, not locked. grok.com add-on still stale (~97h); signing abandoned.
- **Grok Bot** (spoken Sat Oct 10 06:47 AM PT): **50% used**, meter shows **3 days left** (days-left updates ~08:30 each morning). Reset **~Mon Oct 12 ~8 AM PT**. Burn: 31% (Thu 08:21) → 46% (Fri 08:12) → 50% (Sat 06:47). Soft room **~17%/day**. Projected at reset **~58%** (light ~4%/day) to **~80%** (another heavy ~15%/day). No early-warning trip yet; a second 15-point day would be tight. CSC developer HelpDesk line: **0** wakes since last report.
- **HelpDesk**: **25 open**, **0** status/create changes since Fri; unchanged from Oct 8.

## Scorecard
- App since Fri (excluding hermes status / guard / snapshot): **0 real calls**. Since Oct 8 report: **2** AI Editor generate errors Thu 15:53 PT — clef-flash "does not support chat", and OpenRouter "Please log in". Cost $0.
- 7d real app ok_rate **72.7% (16/22)** vs Oct 8's **90.7%**. Failure buckets: openrouter-as-Ollama (2, Wed), phi4:14b not found (2, Mon), clef-flash/login (2, Thu). No app thrash.
- Hermes since Fri: **6 sessions** (+1 open Android-branch TUI on glm). API by model: glm-5.3-flash **290**, grok-4.7 **89**, grok-build-0.1 **19**, north-mini:free **2**, nemotron-lightning:free **6**. Default now **xai-oauth/grok-4.7**. Est OpenRouter cost ~$2.48 (glm).
- Overrun guard since Fri: **5 thrash trips**, all restored (06:10/06:15 grok-4.7↔build; 10:09/10:34/15:29 glm paid thrash → north-mini, restore glm). Targets valid.
- Super Grok daily switch: **yes, fired** Fri; restored overnight. Today under budget (0.8/5.7).
- Tasks: Fri desktop-after-upgrade + Hermes :9101 fixes; Android barcode/update branch continued on glm; Sat morning guest/planning access session on grok-4.7 (~06:24–07:09). Daily switch code live on :4006 (uncommitted). :4006 hand-started after power outage; :5000 still down. No new aisystem commits.

## Proposals (top)
1. Auto-start aisystem :4006 (and :5000) after reboot/power loss so the morning eval and pacing API stay up.
2. Fix AI Editor generate provider routing (still sends 'openrouter' / non-chat Ollama models; login gate for OpenRouter).
3. Cap grok-4.7 context compress earlier (~190K) so heavy TUI days don't burn past the 5.7% daily Super Grok budget before the switch can help open sessions.
